input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Object { mut x: Integer; try { x } catch e { e } } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Supported. C004 lets a TYPED `mut name` defer initialization and makes the FIRST assignment initialize it, so a read before that point is DefiniteAssignmentError rather than a nil read. The row was held on evaluator frame pressure, reproduced twice; the ROOT CAUSE turned out to be the test harness rather than the evaluator. DEPTH_BUDGET was 16 because a default test thread overflowed near 28 frames while the main thread reached ~115, so the bound was an artifact of how the suite was run and any widening of a recursive frame broke it. Test threads now get a real stack, the bound is 64, and the same implementation that overflowed three times passes unchanged.
